    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C# .NET源生成器如何处理Attribute</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        Attribute对.net及源生成器都很重要
可以作为编译参数,影响编译结果
也可以作为源生成器触发条件或参数,影响生成的代码
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<h3 id="1-attribute很重要">1. Attribute很重要</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>作为元数据描述</li>
<li>作为编译参数,影响编译结果</li>
<li>运行是通过反射读取,影响运行结果</li>
<li>作为源生成器触发条件或参数,影响生成的代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-syntaxtree和isymbol">2. SyntaxTree和ISymbol</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>本文探讨基于SyntaxTree和ISymbol处理Attribute</li>
<li>字符串拼接也可以实现,但不在本文讨论范围</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="一attribute解析">一、Attribute解析</h2>
<h3 id="1-attributesyntax">1. AttributeSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AttributeSyntax是Attribute在SyntaxTree中的表现形式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="11-syntaxtree中能包含attribute的对象">1.1 SyntaxTree中能包含Attribute的对象</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>MemberDeclarationSyntax及其子类(TypeDeclarationSyntax、FieldDeclarationSyntax、PropertyDeclarationSyntax和MethodDeclarationSyntax等)</li>
<li>ParameterSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="12-获取attributesyntax的方法">1.2 获取AttributeSyntax的方法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>首先遍历Attribute的对象的属性AttributeLists获取AttributeListSyntax</li>
<li>再遍历AttributeListSyntax的属性Attributes</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = @"public class Product
    {
        [Key, Unique]
        public int ProductId { get; set; }
        [Unique]
        [StringLength(100, MinimumLength = 6)]
        public string ProductName { get; set; }
    }";
var syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source);
var properties = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;PropertyDeclarationSyntax&gt;();
foreach (var property in properties)
{
    var attributeLists = property.AttributeLists;
    foreach (var attributeList in attributeLists)
    {
        var attributes = attributeList.Attributes;
        foreach (AttributeSyntax attribute in attributes)
        {
            var name = attribute.Name.ToFullString();
            Assert.NotEmpty(name);
        }
        Assert.True(attributes.Any());
    }
    Assert.True(attributeLists.Any());
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="13-获取attributes效果截图">1.3 获取Attributes效果截图</h4>
<blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/248830/202608/248830-20260813103614225-1780566163.png" alt="attributes" loading="lazy"></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-attributedata">2. AttributeData</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AttributeData是Attribute在ISymbol中的表现形式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="21-获取attributedata的方法">2.1 获取AttributeData的方法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过ISymbol.GetAttributes方法获取AttributeData</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = @"public class Product
    {
        [Key, Unique]
        public int ProductId { get; set; }
        [Unique]
        [StringLength(100, MinimumLength = 6)]
        public string ProductName { get; set; }
    }";
var driver = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver();
var compilation = driver.Compile(source);
var productType = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("Product");
Assert.NotNull(productType);
var properties = SymbolReflection.GetProperties(productType);
foreach (var property in properties)
{
    var attributes = property.GetAttributes();
    foreach (AttributeData attribute in attributes)
    {
        var name = attribute.AttributeClass!.Name;
        Assert.NotEmpty(name);
    }
    Assert.True(attributes.Any());
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-获取getattributes效果截图">2.2 获取GetAttributes效果截图</h4>
<blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/248830/202608/248830-20260813103642599-1349783489.png" alt="getAttributes" loading="lazy"></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-解析attributedata">3. 解析AttributeData</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>要把AttributeData转化为AttributeSyntax需要先解析AttributeData</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31-attributedata由类型和参数构成">3.1 AttributeData由类型和参数构成</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>类型：AttributeClass</li>
<li>构造函数参数：ConstructorArguments</li>
<li>命名参数：NamedArguments</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class AttributeData
{
    INamedTypeSymbol? AttributeClass { get; }
    ImmutableArray&lt;TypedConstant&gt; ConstructorArguments { get; }
    ImmutableArray&lt;KeyValuePair&lt;string, TypedConstant&gt;&gt; NamedArguments { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-获取typedconstant">3.2 获取TypedConstant</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant方法获取ConstructorArguments</li>
<li>通过SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant方法重载获取NamedArguments</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">string sourceCode = @"
    using System;
    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = true)]
    public class MyAttribute : Attribute;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var type = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MyAttribute");
Assert.NotNull(type);
var attribute = type.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var validOn = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant(attribute, 0);
Assert.NotNull(validOn);
var allowMultiple = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant(attribute, "AllowMultiple");
Assert.NotNull(allowMultiple);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="33-解析typedconstant">3.3 解析TypedConstant</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>TypedConstant由Kind、Type和Value(Values)组成</li>
<li>其中Kind有5种(Error、Primitive、Enum、Type和Array等)</li>
<li>其中Values只有当Kind为Array时才可用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class TypedConstant
{
    TypedConstantKind Kind { get; }
    ITypeSymbol? Type { get; }
    object? Value { get; }
    ImmutableArray&lt;TypedConstant&gt; Values { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="34-把typedconstant转化为type">3.4 把TypedConstant转化为Type</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetTypeSymbol把TypedConstant转化为INamedTypeSymbol</li>
<li>只适用Kind为Type</li>
<li>特别注意,源代码中类型是Type,符号获取时转化为INamedTypeSymbol,无法直接获取Type</li>
<li>在源生成器是使用ITypeSymbol(及其子接口)来反射并不直接使用Type</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;
    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)]
    public class MapAttribute(Type from) : Attribute
    {
        public Type From { get; } = from;
    }
    public record Product(int Id, string Name);
    [Map(typeof(Product))]
    public record ProductDto(int ProductId, string ProductName);
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var type = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.ProductDto");
Assert.NotNull(type);
var attribute = type.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var constant = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant(attribute, 0);
Assert.NotNull(constant);
INamedTypeSymbol attributeType = constant.Value.GetTypeSymbol();
Assert.NotNull(attributeType);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="35-把typedconstant转化为枚举">3.5 把TypedConstant转化为枚举</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetEnum把TypedConstant转化为枚举</li>
<li>只适用Kind为Enum</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;

    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All)]
    public class MyAttribute : Attribute;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var type = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MyAttribute");
Assert.NotNull(type);
var attribute = type.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var validOn = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant(attribute, 0);
Assert.NotNull(validOn);
var targets = validOn.Value.GetEnum&lt;AttributeTargets&gt;();
Assert.Equal(AttributeTargets.All, targets);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="36-把typedconstant转化为常量原始值">3.6 把TypedConstant转化为常量原始值</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetPrimitive把TypedConstant转化为常量原始值</li>
<li>只适用Kind为Primitive</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;
    using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;

    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [Table(""Products"")]
    public record Product(int ProductId, string ProductName);
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver()
    .Reference&lt;TableAttribute&gt;()
    .Compile(sourceCode);
var type = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.Product");
Assert.NotNull(type);
var attribute = type.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var constant = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant(attribute, 0);
Assert.NotNull(constant);
var value = constant.Value.GetPrimitive&lt;string&gt;();
Assert.Equal("Products", value);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="37-把typedconstant转化为数组">3.7 把TypedConstant转化为数组</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetValues把TypedConstant转化为数组</li>
<li>只适用Kind为Array</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;
    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)]
    public class RecognizeAttribute : Attribute
    {
        public string[] Rules { get; set; } = [];
    }
    public record Product(int Id, string Name);
    [Recognize(Rules = [""Id:ProductId"", ""Name:ProductName""])]
    public record ProductDto(int ProductId, string ProductName);
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var type = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.ProductDto");
Assert.NotNull(type);
var attribute = type.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var constant = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant(attribute, "Rules");
Assert.NotNull(constant);
var values = constant.Value.GetValues&lt;string&gt;();
Assert.Equal(["Id:ProductId", "Name:ProductName"], values);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="37-把typedconstant转化为配置值">3.7 把TypedConstant转化为配置值</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetValue把TypedConstant转化为配置值</li>
<li>GetValue可以代替前面四种方法</li>
<li>如果能确定Kind类型还是建议使用对应的专职方法</li>
<li>GetValue实际封装了前面4个方法,按Kind类型调用,性能会有损耗</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;
    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All)]
    public class MyAttribute : Attribute;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var type = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MyAttribute");
Assert.NotNull(type);
var attribute = type.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var constant = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetArgumentConstant(attribute, 0);
Assert.NotNull(constant);
var value = constant.Value.GetValue&lt;AttributeTargets&gt;();
Assert.Equal(AttributeTargets.All, value);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="38-泛型attribute类型参数">3.8 泛型Attribute类型参数</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过AttributeClass获取Attribute实际类型</li>
<li>通过TypeArguments获取泛型参数</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;

    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct | AttributeTargets.Class)]
    public class MapAttribute&lt;TFrom&gt; : Attribute
    {
        public Type From { get; } = typeof(TFrom);
    }
    public readonly record struct User(string Name);
    [Map&lt;User&gt;]
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var syntaxTree = compilation.SyntaxTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(syntaxTree);
var classDeclaration = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().LastOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(classDeclaration);
var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(syntaxTree);
var symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDeclaration);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
var attributeData = symbol.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeData);
var attributeClass = attributeData.AttributeClass;
Assert.NotNull(attributeClass);
var attributeTypeArgument = attributeClass.TypeArguments.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeTypeArgument);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-判断是否包含指定attribute">4 判断是否包含指定Attribute</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>判断Attribute,存在是触发源生成器或其他逻辑的常用方式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="41-判断非泛型attribute">4.1 判断非泛型Attribute</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetTypeByMetadataName获取指定的Attribute类型</li>
<li>通过Equals判断类型是否一致</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;

    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [MyAttribute]
    public class MyClass;
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = true)]
    public class MyAttribute : Attribute;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var attributeSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MyAttribute");
Assert.NotNull(attributeSymbol);
var syntaxTree = compilation.SyntaxTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(syntaxTree);
var classDeclaration = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(classDeclaration);
var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(syntaxTree);
var symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDeclaration);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
var attributeData = symbol.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeData);
Assert.True(attributeSymbol.Equals(attributeData.AttributeClass, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-判断泛型attribute">4.2 判断泛型Attribute</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetTypeByMetadataName获取指定的Attribute类型也支持泛型</li>
<li>通过扩展方法IsGenericType判断是否为泛型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;

    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct | AttributeTargets.Class)]
    public class MapAttribute&lt;TFrom&gt; : Attribute
    {
        public Type From { get; } = typeof(TFrom);
    }
    public readonly record struct User(string Name);
    [Map&lt;User&gt;]
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var attributeSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MapAttribute`1");
Assert.NotNull(attributeSymbol);
var syntaxTree = compilation.SyntaxTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(syntaxTree);
var classDeclaration = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().LastOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(classDeclaration);
var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(syntaxTree);
var symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDeclaration);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
var attributeData = symbol.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeData);
var attributeClass = attributeData.AttributeClass;
Assert.NotNull(attributeClass);
Assert.True(attributeClass.IsGenericType(attributeSymbol));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="43-attribute通用判断">4.3 Attribute通用判断</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetTypeByMetadataName获取指定的泛型Attribute</li>
<li>通过SymbolAttributeHelper.GetAttributesByType方法获取Attribute支持泛型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;

    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct | AttributeTargets.Class)]
    public class MapAttribute(Type from) : Attribute
    {
        public Type From { get; } = from;
    }
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct | AttributeTargets.Class)]
    public class MapAttribute&lt;TFrom&gt; : Attribute
    {
        public Type From { get; } = typeof(TFrom);
    }
    public readonly record struct User(string Name);
    [Map&lt;User&gt;]
    [Map(typeof(User))]
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var attributeSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MapAttribute");
Assert.NotNull(attributeSymbol);
var attributeGenericSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MapAttribute`1");
Assert.NotNull(attributeGenericSymbol);
var syntaxTree = compilation.SyntaxTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(syntaxTree);
var classDeclaration = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().LastOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(classDeclaration);
var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(syntaxTree);
var symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDeclaration);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
var attributeData = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetAttributesByType(symbol, attributeSymbol)
    .FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeData);
var attributeGenericData = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetAttributesByType(symbol, attributeGenericSymbol)
    .FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeGenericData);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="二生成attribute">二、生成Attribute</h2>
<h3 id="1-生成attributesyntax">1. 生成AttributeSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过方法SyntaxFactory.Attribute构造AttributeSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="11-无参的attribute">1.1 无参的Attribute</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var attribute = SyntaxFactory.Attribute(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Fact"));
var code = attribute.ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("Fact", code);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-使用构造函数参数">1.2 使用构造函数参数</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过SyntaxFactory.AttributeArgument方法构造Attribute的参数</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var attributeName = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("InlineData");
var argument = SyntaxFactory.AttributeArgument(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(1));
var attribute = attributeName.Attribute([argument]);
var code = attribute.ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("InlineData(1)", code);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="13-使用命名参数">1.3 使用命名参数</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用ToAttributeArgument扩展方法构造Attribute的参数</li>
<li>使用ToAttributeArgument扩展方法重载构造Attribute的命名参数</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var attributeName = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("AttributeUsage");
var targets = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("AttributeTargets").
    Access("Method");
var inherited = SyntaxGenerator.FalseLiteral;
var attribute = attributeName.Attribute([
    targets.ToAttributeArgument(), 
    inherited.ToAttributeArgument("Inherited")]);
var code = attribute.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method, Inherited = false)", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-把attributesyntax附加到syntaxtree">2. 把AttributeSyntax附加到SyntaxTree</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用ToSingletonList把AttributeSyntax转化为独立的AttributeListSyntax</li>
<li>还可以用SyntaxFactory.AttributeList合并多个AttributeListSyntax</li>
<li>使用AddAttributeLists方法附加AttributeSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var attribute = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Fact").Attribute();
var method = SyntaxGenerator.VoidType.Method("Simple")
    .WithBody(SyntaxFactory.Block())
    .AddAttributeLists(attribute.ToSingletonList());
var code = method.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("[Fact]", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-判断attributedata是否适合当前节点">3. 判断AttributeData是否适合当前节点</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该场景是把ISymbol的AttributeData附加到SyntaxTree之前先验证是否适用</li>
<li>由于Attribute有ValidOn属性,不符合编译会报错</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31-只判断attributetargets">3.1 只判断AttributeTargets</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AttributeSymbolCacher用于缓存Attribute的类型信息,避免相同类型重复解析</li>
<li>以下示例为由结构体User生成类UserDTO,尝试把MyAttribute复制过去</li>
<li>通过VerifyTarget验证原Attribute是否能用于类UserDTO</li>
<li>由于MyAttribute只能用于结构体,所以MyAttribute无法复制到UserDTO</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct)]
    public class MyAttribute : Attribute;
    [MyAttribute]
    public readonly record struct User(string Name);
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var sourceType = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("User");
Assert.NotNull(sourceType);
var attribute = sourceType.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var destType = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("UserDTO");
Assert.NotNull(destType);
var attributeCacher = new AttributeSymbolCacher(compilation);
Assert.False(attributeCacher.VerifyTarget(AttributeTargets.Class, attribute));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-判断attributetarget及与目标是否冲突">3.2 判断AttributeTarget及与目标是否冲突</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AttributeSymbolCacher用于缓存Attribute的类型信息,避免相同类型重复解析</li>
<li>以下示例为由结构体User生成类UserDTO,尝试把MyAttribute复制过去</li>
<li>通过Verify验证原Attribute是否能用于类UserDTO及是否冲突</li>
<li>虽然MyAttribute也可用于类,但UserDTO已经有一个MyAttribute,所以还是无法复制到UserDTO</li>
<li>Verify还有属性、字段、函数和参数的重载,这些都类似,就不重复举例了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct | AttributeTargets.Class, AllowMultiple = false))]
    public class MyAttribute : Attribute;
    [MyAttribute]
    public readonly record struct User(string Name);
    [MyAttribute]
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var sourceType = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("User");
Assert.NotNull(sourceType);
var attribute = sourceType.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var destType = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("UserDTO");
Assert.NotNull(destType);
var attributeCacher = new AttributeSymbolCacher(compilation);
Assert.False(attributeCacher.Verify(destType, attribute));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-把attributedata转化为attributesyntax">4. 把AttributeData转化为AttributeSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过ToSyntax扩展方法把AttributeData转化为AttributeSyntax</li>
<li>namespaces是生成AttributeSyntax需要添加的命名空间</li>
<li>如果把生成的AttributeSyntax附加到SyntaxTree,namespaces也需要同步添加</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;
    namespace GenerateCoreTests;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct | AttributeTargets.Class))]
    public class MyAttribute(int value) : Attribute
    {
        public int Value { get; } = value;
    }
    [My(3)]
    public readonly record struct User(string Name);
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var sourceType = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("GenerateCoreTests.User");
Assert.NotNull(sourceType);
AttributeData? attribute = sourceType.GetAttributes().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
List&lt;string&gt; namespaces = [];
AttributeSyntax attributeSyntax = attribute.ToSyntax(namespaces);
var code = attributeSyntax.ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("My(3)", code);
Assert.Single(namespaces);
Assert.Equal("GenerateCoreTests", namespaces[0]);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-演示完整的attribute操作">5. 演示完整的Attribute操作</h3>
<h4 id="51-源生成流程的case">5.1 源生成流程的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过GetSemanticModel方法获取模型</li>
<li>通过GetDeclaredSymbol方法解析当前类型符号</li>
<li>通过GetTypeByMetadataName方法获取Attribute泛型</li>
<li>判断当前类型符号是否包含指定Attribute及源类型</li>
<li>通过SymbolReflection.GetConstructors方法获取源类型构造函数</li>
<li>通过源类型构造函数获取源类型参数</li>
<li>获取源类型参数的Attribute并调用ToSyntax扩展方法转化为AttributeSyntax</li>
<li>按源类型参数构造目标类型属性并添加AttributeSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    using System;
    using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
    using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;

    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Struct | AttributeTargets.Class)]
    public class MapAttribute&lt;TFrom&gt; : Attribute
    {
        public Type From { get; } = typeof(TFrom);
    }
    public readonly record struct User([StringLength(100)]string Name);
    [Map&lt;User&gt;]
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var syntaxTree = compilation.SyntaxTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(syntaxTree);
var classDeclaration = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().LastOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(classDeclaration);
var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(syntaxTree);
var symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDeclaration);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
var attributeSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.MapAttribute`1");
Assert.NotNull(attributeSymbol);
var attributeData = SymbolAttributeHelper.GetAttributesByType(symbol, attributeSymbol)
    .FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeData);
var attributeClass = attributeData.AttributeClass;
Assert.NotNull(attributeClass);
var sourceSymbol = attributeClass.TypeArguments.FirstOrDefault() as INamedTypeSymbol;
Assert.NotNull(sourceSymbol);
var constructor = SymbolReflection.GetConstructors(sourceSymbol)
    .FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(constructor);
var parameterSymbol = constructor.Parameters.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(parameterSymbol);
var attributeCacher = new AttributeSymbolCacher(compilation);
var attribute = attributeCacher.GetAttributes(parameterSymbol, AttributeTargets.Property)
    .FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attribute);
var attributeNamespaces = new List&lt;string&gt;();
var attributeSyntax = attribute.ToSyntax(attributeNamespaces);
var attributeNamespace = attributeNamespaces.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(attributeNamespace);
var propertyType = parameterSymbol.Type.ToSyntax();
var property = propertyType.GetSetProperty(parameterSymbol.Name)
    .Public()
    .AddAttributeLists(attributeSyntax.ToSingletonList());
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration(classDeclaration.Identifier)
    .WithModifiers(classDeclaration.Modifiers)
    .AddMembers(property);
var @namespace = SyntaxFactory.NamespaceDeclaration(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName(symbol.ContainingNamespace.Name))
    .AddUsings(SyntaxFactory.UsingDirective(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName(attributeNamespace)))
    .AddMembers(type);
var code = @namespace.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("[StringLength(100)]", code);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="52-生成的代码">5.2 生成的代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>原类型Name参数的Attribute被完美的复制到目标类Name属性上</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace ExampleNamespace
{
    using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

    public partial class UserDTO
    {
        [StringLength(100)]
        public string Name { get; set; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三实现说明">三、实现说明</h2>
<h3 id="1-示例执行说明">1. 示例执行说明</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以上代码执行依赖开源项目EasySyntax、Hand.GenerateCore和Hand.Generators.SyntaxScripting,nuget包如下</li>
<li>Hand.Generators.EasySyntax --version 0.2.1.4</li>
<li>Hand.GenerateCore --version 0.2.1.6</li>
<li>Hand.Generators.SyntaxScripting --version 0.2.1.4-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
